requests.prompt: Use case: production game asset, stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated hand-painted storybook world prop matching the supplied approved Trætoppen paintings: tactile matte gouache and watercolor pigment, softly irregular warm pencil contours, rounded functional construction, readable beside the chibi fox. Reference 1 (heroes.png) establishes the approved drawing language and scale; reference 2 (icons_resources.png) establishes matte physical materials and pigment; reference 3 (generated_floor_2 screenshot) establishes the forest palette and slightly top-down world viewing angle. These are STYLE references, not edit targets. Keep all reference art unchanged. Camera: shallow three-quarter view slightly from above, upright verticals, consistent approximately 36 degree elevation. Single centered cutout, real transparent alpha background, generous 15 percent gutters. No floor rectangle, cast shadow, baked aura, broad glow, labels, readable writing, text or watermark. Preserve the warm cream, honey wood, moss/sage, muted iron/brass palette with tiny quiet teal/gold accents. Avoid glossy plastic, photorealism, vector icons, neon, faceted low-poly surfaces and horror gore. Paint a small well-used forest lantern with dull brass, worn honey timber handle, clear glass and a narrow cream cloth grip repair with exactly three short diagonal stitches, large enough to remain recognizable at 100-150 pixels in game. The three stitches are its personal repair mark. Show a tiny warm wick inside the glass; light spill will be a separate game layer. One physical object, no extra versions or detached parts.
